ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Century Vision Private Limited, a promoter group entity of Beekay Steel Industries Ltd., acquired 22,000 equity shares (representing 0.12% of voting capital) via open market on September 11, 2026. This transaction increased the promoter group's total stake in Beekay Steel from 19.39% to 19.51%, indicating a minor consolidation of control. There are no immediate red flags, as an increase in promoter holding typically signals confidence in the company's future.
